newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends slightly firmer vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends slightly firmer vs dollar.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar on Tuesday but was static in afternoon trade, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit closed on the central bank's resistance level at its midday level of 167.50/60, compared to an opening of 167.70/80.
"It was almost exclusively forex selling today, keeping the forint right at the top of the band," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
Butor said high forint interest rates were keeping demand high.
Overnight rates finished at 26.50 percent on Tuesday, above the opening levels of 25 percent and also above Monday's close of 24.50 percent, but below the day's peak of 27 percent.
Moderate turnover in the currency futures section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was shared mainly between sterling, the Ecu and the Swiss franc.
Sterling ended mostly higher while the Ecu and Swiss franc weakened for most maturities.
